errors.reloadBeforeAccept: Reload the mission before accepting it.
errors.completionRequired: Enter a result note and the equipment condition on return.
errors.failureReasonRequired: Enter the reason the mission could not be completed.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason must not exceed 500 characters.
errors.quantityInvalid: Equipment quantity must be a whole number greater than 0.
errors.quantityExceeded: The requested quantity exceeds the available equipment.
errors.uavRedispatchReasonRequired: Enter a reason for reassigning the UAV.
errors.currentUavUnknown: The current UAV could not be determined. Reload the mission.
errors.replacementUavRequired: Choose a different UAV as the replacement.

apiErrors.MISSION_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: The operator must accept the current assignment before it can be marked ready or started.
apiErrors.MISSION_ACCEPTANCE_STALE: The assignment has changed or was already accepted. Review the latest resources before confirming.
apiErrors.MISSION_HANDOVER_NOTES_REQUIRED: A result note and the equipment condition on return are required.
apiErrors.MISSION_HANDOVER_RESULT_REQUIRED: At least one Deliverable or Report file must be uploaded and attached successfully.
apiErrors.MISSION_MEDIA_LOCKED: The mission has ended. Files can only be viewed and downloaded.
apiErrors.MISSION_DISPATCH_STALE: The assignment was changed on another screen. Data has been reloaded; check it before trying again.
apiErrors.MISSION_RESERVATION_STALE: The reservation was changed or released. Check the latest list.
apiErrors.MISSION_STATION_RESOURCES_CONFLICT: Resources belong to different stations. Remove the UAV and release equipment from the old station before changing stations.
apiErrors.MISSION_RESERVATION_BALANCE_CONFLICT: Reserved inventory does not match the missions. Nothing was released to avoid taking another mission's share.
apiErrors.MISSION_DISPATCH_REQUIRED: Resources are already assigned. Use reassignment instead.
apiErrors.OPERATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE: The operator must have the right role, be active and not locked.
apiErrors.MISSION_UAV_ASSIGNMENT_STALE: The mission UAV was changed elsewhere. Information has been reloaded; check the current UAV before continuing.
apiErrors.MISSION_INVALID_STATUS: The mission status has changed. Information has been reloaded; please check it before continuing.
apiErrors.MISSION_RESOURCE_MISSING: Not enough valid resources. Check the station, UAV, operator and equipment.
apiErrors.UAV_NOT_AVAILABLE: This UAV is not currently available.
apiErrors.UAV_TIME_CONFLICT: The UAV is already scheduled in this time slot.
apiErrors.OPERATOR_TIME_CONFLICT: The operator is already scheduled in this time slot.

errors.loadFailed: Unable to load the mission, or you do not have access.
errors.forbidden: You no longer have permission for this action or are not the assigned operator.
errors.actionUnconfirmed: The result of the action could not be confirmed. Check the reloaded status before trying again.
errors.reloadStale: The latest status could not be loaded. Reload the status before continuing to avoid repeating the action.
errors.uploadUnconfirmed: The file attachment could not be confirmed. Check the reloaded list before trying again.
errors.downloadFailed: Unable to download the file right now. Please try again.
errors.reloadFailed: Unable to reload the status. Check your connection and try again.

resources.selectEquipmentFirst: Select equipment to enter the quantity to reserve.
resources.title: Resource allocation

awaitingAcceptance.title: Awaiting operator acceptance
awaitingAcceptance.body: The assignee must review the resources and accept the mission before it is ready. Each resource change requires acceptance again.

complete.evidenceCount: {count} deliverable/report file(s) attached. At least 1 file is required to complete.
complete.evidenceUnknown: Result files could not be checked. Reload the list or ask someone with file access.
complete.evidenceOptional: This mission type does not require result files.
complete.warning: Completing releases resources and locks file updates. Check the results before confirming.

detail.cancelWarning: A cancelled mission cannot be resumed. Resources are released according to the process.
detail.failWarning: This ends the mission and releases held resources. The mission cannot be resumed; the reason is saved in the history.

note.equipmentConditionHint: This note does not change the equipment's damaged or maintenance status.

uav.title: Reassign UAV
uav.description: Replace or remove the UAV only before the mission starts. The station, operator and reserved equipment are kept. The operator's acceptance is reset; the mission must be reviewed before continuing.
uav.replaceHint: The old UAV is released only when the replacement is valid. If the mission is ready, it returns to resource allocation for review.
uav.unassignHint: The mission returns to confirmed. Assign another UAV before it can be ready.
uav.noReplacement: No available UAV matches the station. Check the UAV fleet or finish maintenance first.
uav.reasonHint: Up to {count} characters. The reason is saved in the mission history.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.billingError: Invoice could not be issued; the system will retry

media.title: Files and results
media.uploadHint: A file counts toward handover once it is uploaded, confirmed and attached to the mission. Flight data does not replace result/report files.
media.noPermission: You do not have permission to view files.
media.locked: The mission has ended. Files are kept for reference.

timeline.title: Mission history
timeline.noPermission: You do not have permission to view the history.

redispatch.title: Reassign operator, station and equipment
redispatch.description: Changes before flight need a reason and a resource re-check. A ready mission returns to allocation; the operator must review the new assignment.
redispatch.noReservations: No equipment reserved. Reserve at least one valid item before marking ready.
redispatch.stationHint: Before changing station, remove the UAV and release equipment from the other station. Removing the station requires removing the UAV and releasing all equipment. The operator is kept.
redispatch.equipmentHint: Reservation #{id} holds {quantity}. Select the same equipment to change the quantity; the system releases the old reservation and creates the new one in a single step. Leave the selection empty to release this reservation entirely.

schedule.available: No schedule conflict. The system checks again on confirmation.
schedule.conflict: The operator is unavailable or already scheduled. Choose someone else.
schedule.error: The schedule could not be checked.

redispatch.maxQuantity: Maximum reservable: {count}. This is the new total for the reservation being changed.
redispatch.reasonHint: Up to {count} characters. Saved in the mission history.
redispatch.stale: The data has changed. Close and reopen the form to use the latest assignment.

overview.partialError: Some metrics could not be loaded. Other modules remain available.

fleet.title: UAV fleet status
fleet.subtitle: Select a UAV to see its latest telemetry
fleet.empty: No UAVs yet, or you do not have permission to view them.

hud.noTelemetry: This UAV has not reported telemetry.
hud.staleFix: Last packet {seconds} s ago at {lat}, {lng} — link lost
